king-vasabha.name: King Vasabha
king-vasabha.summary: King Vasabha was an important ruler of the Anuradhapura Kingdom.
king-vasabha.biography: King Vasabha is described in the chronicles as an important ruler of the Anuradhapura Kingdom. He was succeeded by King Vankanasika Tissa.
importantEvents: Associated with the First Lambakanna Dynasty
Traditionally identified as the father of Vankanasika Tissa

king-vankanasika-tissa.name: King Vankanasika Tissa
king-vankanasika-tissa.summary: King Vankanasika Tissa succeeded King Vasabha as ruler of the Anuradhapura Kingdom.
king-vankanasika-tissa.biography: King Vankanasika Tissa was a ruler of the Anuradhapura Kingdom. Traditional sources identify him as the son of King Vasabha. He was succeeded by King Gajabahu I.
importantEvents: Belonged to the First Lambakanna Dynasty
Traditionally identified as the father of King Gajabahu I

king-gajabahu-i.name: King Gajabahu I
king-gajabahu-i.summary: King Gajabahu I succeeded King Vankanasika Tissa.
king-gajabahu-i.biography: King Gajabahu I was a ruler of the Anuradhapura Kingdom. He is traditionally identified as the son of King Vankanasika Tissa and is remembered as an important ruler in Sri Lankan chronicles and later traditions.
